payload.name: KINK
payload.creator: 0x641ad626b45c6c061112c48e45002ad811148bf2
payload.description: $KINK didn’t come from us. In October 2024, Bankless asked Ink founder Andrew Koller if the chain would ever launch a token and what it might be named. He shut down any official token plans, but then he mentioned that people on the team had been throwing around “kink” as a joke and that it would probably spawn a bunch of memes. That nickname was circulating internally before Ink even launched mainnet. We just took the joke and put it on-chain. 100% of fees used for buybacks and burns.
